# RegistryReady

RegistryReady is a free, browser-based validator and generator for official MCP Registry server.json metadata.

## Tools and guides
- / — Validate MCP server.json metadata.
- /mcp-server-json-generator — Generate a minimal registry file.
- /mcp-registry-publish-checklist — Prepare for mcp-publisher.
- /mcp-remote-server-json — Configure remote server metadata.

The tool checks the official 2025-12-11 schema reference, required metadata, packages, remotes, transports, version parity, secrets, local URLs, and the 4 KB registry limit. Input is processed locally.
